name: Voxel Generation with Diffusion Models
definition: Uses a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) to generate voxelized shapes. The goal is to learn a parameterized Markov chain that generates novel samples after finite time steps.
summary: Voxel Generation with Diffusion Models synthesizes novel 3D binary voxel grids from noise, distinguishing itself by producing explicit, discrete volumetric representations suitable for mesh extraction.
